CFML Language Reference: Functions

Now

Returns the server's current local date and time as a date/time value.

Category

Date and time functions

Syntax

Now()

Returns

A date/time value, which prints as {ts '1999-10-22 21:42:00'}.

Usage

Now() reads the server's clock, not the browser's. Use DateFormat and TimeFormat to make it presentable, DateConvert to turn it into UTC, and DateAdd to calculate dates relative to today. The value is precise to the second; for timing code, use GetTickCount.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Right_Now = Now()>
<CFOUTPUT>
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TD>Now()</TD><TD>#Right_Now#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Formatted</TD><TD>#DateFormat(Right_Now, "dddd, mmmm d, yyyy")# at #TimeFormat(Right_Now, "h:mm tt")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>A week from now</TD><TD>#DateFormat(DateAdd("ww", 1, Right_Now), "mmmm d, yyyy")#</TD></TR>
<TR><TD>Days since Jan 1, 2000</TD><TD>#DateDiff("d", CreateDate(2000, 1, 1), Right_Now)#</TD></TR>
</TABLE>
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

DateFormat, TimeFormat, DateAdd, GetTickCount, CreateDateTime
